alternates.description: Skylight replacement (4 units per their count)

exclusions_declared: Cover board (optional upgrade $38,000) — contractor states typically not installed on industrial buildings this age
Tapered insulation for ponding (optional upgrade $22,000-$35,000) — contractor recommends addressing only if leaks occur
HVAC curb modifications ($3,200 per unit; est. 4-6)
Skylight work ($4,800/skylight; contractor counted 4 vs RFP 12)
Additional insulation above R-30 ($3.20/sq ft per R-value)
Waste disposal fee escalation (actual cost adjustment)
Material price escalation if start delayed >60 days
Phasing coordination if schedule extends beyond 90 days ($2,500/week supervision)
Daily cleanup — substituted with weekly if daily not feasible
clarifications: Assumes steel deck is sound, minimal repair
Assumes wood deck in acceptable condition
Assumes building vacated or normal operations continue (contradicts RFP: occupied pharma warehouse with phasing requirement)
Assumes phasing can be accomplished within 90 days
Assumes cover board not required for building type
Assumes ponding does not require correction unless active leaks
Asserts mechanically attached system is equivalent to fully adhered for this application

substitutions_proposed.equivalence_justification: Contractor asserts 'mechanically attached systems are industry standard for buildings of this type and provide equivalent performance to fully adhered at lower cost.' No engineering calculation or manufacturer approval provided.

substitutions_proposed.spec_item: Cover board (1/4 inch gypsum or HD polyiso per RFP scope)
substitutions_proposed.substitute_offered: No cover board in base bid
substitutions_proposed.equivalence_justification: Contractor asserts cover board 'typically not required for industrial buildings unless specified by manufacturer for warranty purposes.' This contradicts RFP included_items.

substitutions_proposed.spec_item: Tapered insulation or added drains to resolve ponding (RFP scope)
substitutions_proposed.equivalence_justification: Contractor states ponding is 'common on roofs of this age and does not necessarily indicate failure.' Direct conflict with RFP included_items.

substitutions_proposed.spec_item: Daily cleanup on occupied site (RFP scope)
substitutions_proposed.substitute_offered: Weekly cleanup if daily not feasible
substitutions_proposed.equivalence_justification: Exclusion item 25 — no justification beyond site-conditions caveat.

materials_system.manufacturer: Not specified (product data sheets attached per cover letter, manufacturer name not disclosed in bid body)

technical_approach.narrative: Competitive base price; transparent extras. Asserts phasing possible, flexible start, but provides no dedicated phasing/tenant coordination plan; Assumption #5 even contemplates 'building vacated or operations continue normally' — inconsistent with RFP occupied-pharma phasing requirement.
technical_approach.weather_protection_plan: Not described; exclusion #23 charges extra for weekend weather protection
technical_approach.fall_protection_plan: Generic: 'Fall protection equipment provided' (Safety Program section)
technical_approach.waste_disposal_plan: Not described beyond line-item 'Roof removal and disposal $78,000' and exclusion #18 for disposal-fee escalation

wsib_clearance.evidence: Attachments list 'WSIB Clearance Certificate' and 'WSIB Experience Rating Letter (1.12)'; WSIB Account #3456789-01 cited. No clearance date or good-standing text in bid body.
wsib_clearance.notes: Owner to verify validity window and good-standing text via clearances.wsib.ca per fixture 04 §1.4. Experience Rating 1.12 (>1.00) signals above-average claims history — captured as qualifications red flag.

cgl_insurance.evidence: CGL $5,000,000 per occurrence meets RFP §5.1.2 minimum. Cover letter does not state owner named as additional insured nor completed-operations tail years; COI attached per exhibit list but not quoted.
cgl_insurance.notes: Owner must verify COI names Tenebrus Capital as additional insured and carries ≥2 yr completed-operations coverage (RFP §5.1.2).

bid_bond.evidence: RFP §9.2 does not require a bid bond (bid_bond_percent = null; only 50% performance and 50% L&M bonds required). Bid contains no bid bond but none was required.
bid_bond.notes: Performance and L&M bonding capacity not explicitly declared; owner should confirm surety consent before award.

working_at_heights.evidence: Safety Program section lists 'Written safety procedures' and 'Fall protection equipment provided' but does not confirm all on-site workers hold current O. Reg. 297/13 Working-at-Heights training. RFP §5.1 requires confirmation.
working_at_heights.notes: Fixture 04 §3 requires explicit WAH confirmation. Silence = fail; owner can resolve via addendum/clarification.

addenda_acknowledgment.evidence: No addenda acknowledgment statement in the bid. Cover letter cites RFP number only.
addenda_acknowledgment.notes: If any addenda were issued (RFP does not list any in the manifest), acknowledgment is missing — clarify with owner.

non_collusion.evidence: No non-collusion declaration text visible in bid; not listed in attachments.
non_collusion.notes: RFP mandatory_requirements.non_collusion_declaration_required=true. Owner to confirm whether a signed declaration was submitted separately.

site_visit.evidence: Cover letter: 'We attended the site visit on March 25, 2026.' RFP site_meeting_mandatory=true.

years_in_business.evidence: 'operating in the Greater Toronto Area since 2010' (cover letter). 2026 - 2010 = 16 years, exceeds RFP §5.1.3 minimum of 10.

similar_projects.evidence: Three references provided (Smallwood 2024 48k sqft, Valley View 2023 52k sqft, Eastgate 2025 67k sqft) — count meets RFP §5.1.4 minimum of 3. All within 5-year recency and commercial low-slope class. However, project values not disclosed — comparable test (0.5×-2× subject value) cannot be verified from bid alone.
similar_projects.notes: Owner to request reference project values to confirm 0.5×-2× comparability per qualification-check Gate 8.

red_flags.description: Base bid excludes cover board — directly contradicts RFP included scope (§3.1 cover board required) and voids TPO manufacturer warranty over polyiso assemblies.
red_flags.citation: RFP §3.1 / fixture 02 §4 — cover board required over polyiso for single-ply system warranty
red_flags.evidence: Cover letter Exclusion #4: 'Cover board - Not included in base bid. Optional upgrade at $38,000.'

red_flags.description: Mechanically attached TPO proposed in lieu of RFP-specified fully-adhered system. No manufacturer approval or wind-uplift calculation provided; equivalence justification is unsupported assertion.
red_flags.evidence: Key Specifications: 'Mechanically attached system.' Assumption #15: 'Mechanically attached system acceptable (equivalent to fully adhered for this application).'

red_flags.description: Tapered insulation / ponding resolution excluded; contractor dismisses ponding as 'superficial' — direct contradiction of RFP included_items requiring ponding resolution.
red_flags.citation: RFP §3.1 included_items 'Tapered insulation or added drains to resolve ponding'
red_flags.evidence: Exclusion #5 and Additional Notes: 'Ponding water is common on roofs of this age and does not necessarily indicate failure.'

red_flags.description: Warranty is 20-year manufacturer 'limited' on membrane only — material_only tier, not the total_system_ndl required. Workmanship warranty only 1 year vs RFP §9.6 minimum 2 years. No manufacturer-certified-installer status declared.
red_flags.citation: RFP warranty_requirements (20 yr total_system_ndl, 2 yr workmanship, manufacturer certification required) / fixture 02 §1 warranty taxonomy
red_flags.evidence: Warranty section: 'Manufacturer Warranty: 20-year limited warranty on TPO membrane. Workmanship Warranty: 1 year on installation.'

red_flags.description: Working-at-Heights training (O. Reg. 297/13) not explicitly confirmed; only generic 'Fall protection equipment provided.' Fails RFP mandatory gate.
red_flags.evidence: Safety Program section — no WAH training statement.

red_flags.description: Assumption #5 ('Building will be vacated or operations can continue normally during work') directly contradicts RFP project.occupied_during_work=true and §11.1 phased occupied pharma warehouse requirement. No phasing plan submitted.
Skylight count discrepancy: RFP specifies 12 skylights; bidder 'counted 4 during site visit' and prices work only for 4. Any replacement beyond 4 billed at $4,800/skylight as extra.

25+ listed exclusions and open-ended cost adjusters (material escalation, waste-fee escalation, temperature monitoring, weekend weather protection) transfer price risk to owner and undermine bid comparability.
red_flags.evidence: Cover letter 'IMPORTANT EXCLUSIONS' list (25 items) + final NOTE TO BIDDER warning at bid foot.

red_flags.description: WSIB Experience Rating 1.12 is above industry average (1.00 baseline) — financial/claims-history signal per fixture 04 §5. Warrants review of 3-year claims history before award.

No manufacturer certification (GAF Master Elite, Soprema PAQ+S, Firestone Red Shield, Sika Sarnafil, etc.) declared; TPO system manufacturer itself not named in bid body. RFP manufacturer_certification_required=true.
red_flags.evidence: No certification program cited anywhere in bid; TPO manufacturer omitted from Key Specifications.

red_flags.description: Reference project values not disclosed — comparability (0.5×-2× of $468k subject value) cannot be verified. All three references are commercial low-slope within 5 years (positive signal), but Smallwood at 48k sqft and Valley View at 52k sqft are materially smaller than the 85k sqft subject roof.
red_flags.evidence: References section lists name, location, sqft, contact but no project value.

red_flags.description: No fall-protection plan, anchor-point strategy, weather-protection plan, tear-off staging plan, or site-safety plan attached. Occupied pharma warehouse with 47 penetrations demands a specific plan.
red_flags.citation: fixture 01 §3 / CSA Z91 / OBC occupied-building precautions
red_flags.evidence: Technical approach sections absent; cover letter contains only generic statements.

red_flags.description: Wind-uplift design basis (CSA A123.21 or FM 1-29) not stated — required for commercial low-slope, especially when attachment method is being substituted to mechanically fastened.
red_flags.evidence: Key Specifications omits wind-uplift figures; no wind_uplift_coverage_mph claimed in warranty.

red_flags.description: Front-loaded payment schedule (20% mobilization + 30% progress + 30% substantial + 10% holdback) concentrates owner risk. Construction Act holdback respected, but 20% mobilization is above GTA commercial norm (~10%).
red_flags.evidence: Payment Schedule section and note 'We require larger upfront payment due to material procurement costs.'

red_flags.description: Bid does not identify TPO manufacturer — impossible to confirm warranty eligibility or manufacturer acceptable-list fit.

extraction_notes: TPO manufacturer name not stated in bid body despite Product Data Sheets being listed as an attachment — owner to request the PDS or bid copy to identify.
WSIB clearance certificate date and good-standing wording not extractable from cover letter alone; relies on attachment text.
COI attached but owner-named-additional-insured status and completed-operations tail years not stated in cover letter — requires COI review.
Bonding capacity and surety consent for performance/L&M bonds not declared.
Non-collusion declaration not referenced in bid or attachment list.
Addenda acknowledgment not present — unknown whether any addenda were issued for TC-ROOF-2026-001.
Reference project dollar values not disclosed; comparability test (Gate 8) cannot be completed.
Crew size, foreman name, and mobilization-days-after-award not stated.
Wind-uplift design basis and wind_uplift_coverage_mph not stated.
Insulation layer stagger (RFP requires two staggered layers) not described.

_provenance.pricing.hst_included: Bid Summary shows base $468,000 + HST $60,840 separately
_provenance.scope_response.substitutions_proposed: Key Specifications + Assumption #15 (mechanically attached); Exclusion #4 (cover board); Exclusion #5 (ponding)
_provenance.warranty_offered.warranty_type: '20-year limited warranty on TPO membrane' (membrane-only = material_only tier per fixture 02 §1)
_provenance.mandatory_gates.site_visit: Cover letter: 'We attended the site visit on March 25, 2026'

sub_factors.name: Tear-off & staging
sub_factors.rationale: No tear-off or staging plan described; bid omits dumpster placement, lift strategy, staging zones.

sub_factors.name: Weather protection / dry-in
sub_factors.rationale: Not addressed; Exclusion #23 charges extra for weekend weather protection rather than committing to a dry-in plan.

sub_factors.name: Fall protection & safety
sub_factors.rationale: Generic 'Fall protection equipment provided' statement; no named anchor points, no parapet/perimeter plan.

sub_factors.name: Waste / environmental / logistics
sub_factors.rationale: Disposal mentioned as a line item ($78,000 roof removal and disposal); no DSA plan or recycling commitments.

sub_factors.name: Quality control / inspection protocol
sub_factors.rationale: No QC checkpoints, manufacturer inspections, or final walk-through process described.

technical_approach.summary: No tear-off/staging, dry-in, or QC plan; only generic fall-protection and line-item disposal — technical approach is skeletal.

sub_factors.name: Warranty type vs RFP requirement
sub_factors.rationale: 20-year limited warranty on TPO membrane = material_only tier; RFP required total_system_ndl (non-compliant but scored at tier offered).

sub_factors.name: Warranty years vs RFP minimum
sub_factors.rationale: 20 years meets RFP minimum of 20 manufacturer years.

sub_factors.name: Installer certification at claimed warranty tier
sub_factors.rationale: No manufacturer certification declared; TPO manufacturer itself not named in bid body.

sub_factors.name: Workmanship warranty years
sub_factors.rationale: 1-year workmanship warranty — below RFP 2-year minimum and below market median.

sub_factors.name: Materials quality
sub_factors.rationale: 60 mil TPO meets thickness but no cover board over polyiso — below industry standard per fixture 02 §4.

warranty_materials.summary: 20-yr material_only warranty (RFP requires total_system_ndl), 1-yr workmanship below minimum, no certified installer, missing cover board degrades materials quality.

sub_factors.name: Count of comparable references
sub_factors.rationale: 3 commercial low-slope refs within 5 years, but values undisclosed and two (48k/52k sqft) are materially smaller than 85k subject — comparability unverifiable; credited as 1-2 comparable.

sub_factors.name: Recency of most-recent comparable reference
sub_factors.rationale: Eastgate Commerce Centre completed 2025 (<1 year before bid).

sub_factors.name: Verifiability
sub_factors.rationale: Named contact, phone, completion year and sqft on every reference; project values omitted across all three.

experience_references.summary: Three recent commercial low-slope refs — Eastgate 2025 very recent — but project values undisclosed so 0.5x-2x comparability is unverifiable.

sub_factors.name: Years in business
sub_factors.rationale: 16 years (since 2010) exceeds 15+ year threshold.

sub_factors.name: Manufacturer certification at or above warranty tier
sub_factors.rationale: No manufacturer certification declared; TPO manufacturer not even named.

sub_factors.name: Skilled Trades C of Q crew
sub_factors.rationale: Zero Certificate of Qualification roofers identified in bid.

sub_factors.name: Industry membership
sub_factors.rationale: Not a CRCA member; no regional/provincial association membership disclosed.

qualifications_certifications.summary: Strong tenure (16 yrs), but zero manufacturer certification, no C of Q roofers disclosed, and no CRCA/association membership.

sub_factors.name: Timeline realism vs scope
sub_factors.rationale: 90-day duration is realistic for 85k sqft scope; no phase sequencing or milestones provided.

sub_factors.name: Crew adequacy
sub_factors.rationale: Crew size not stated; no foreman named.

sub_factors.name: Mobilization and completion dates vs RFP
sub_factors.rationale: Substantial completion date 2026-08-15 provided; mobilization-days-after-award not stated.

sub_factors.name: Occupied-building accommodation
sub_factors.rationale: accommodates_occupied_building=false; Assumption #5 contemplates a vacated building — direct conflict with RFP occupied pharma phasing requirement.

schedule.summary: 90-day duration is plausible, but crew size, foreman, mobilization, and occupied-building accommodation are all missing or contradicted.

strengths: 16 years in business — exceeds RFP minimum of 10 and clears the 15+ tenure tier.
References are all recent commercial low-slope (Eastgate 2025, Smallwood 2024, Valley View 2023) within 5-year window.
60 mil TPO membrane thickness itself meets RFP specification.
weaknesses: Warranty is material_only with 1-yr workmanship and no certified installer — non-compliant with RFP total_system_ndl + 2-yr workmanship + certification requirements.
Technical approach is skeletal: no tear-off/staging, dry-in, QC, or occupied-building phasing plan; Assumption #5 even presumes a vacated building.
scoring_rationale.differentiator: Lowest-headline base bid, but built on excluded cover board, mechanically-attached substitution, and 25+ exclusions that transfer substantial price and scope risk to the owner.
